explication: ComfyUI-3D-Pack is a ComfyUI custom-node suite for generating and processing 3D assets with multiple model families. The principal workflow is to supply an image, prompt, or existing mesh to a ComfyUI node, run a selected generation or multiview stage, optionally texture the resulting mesh, and return mesh or image outputs. The README documents substantial model branches beyond the sampled source; those are represented at their existing subsystem paths, with unverified runtime dispatch shown as dashed. Source excerpts are limited, so most branch connections reflect documented capabilities rather than inspected node wiring.
